name: RC-B10-0476/2026 – § 5/1
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the escalation of Russian strikes in the EU, particularly on Black Sea shipping, threatening human life, regional stability and food security
part_text: ‘Recalls that attacks within, or in the immediate vicinity of, Member States’ territorial waters and in their EEZs, where coastal states hold sovereign rights, threaten the security of the EU as a whole and that Member States on the Black Sea cannot be left to face this threat alone;’
